_doc: Han van Meegeren (BIBLE.md cast row): Dutch painter in his mid-fifties, lean face, receding dark hair combed back, sharp clever eyes; brow-led face (browThick 1.3, eyeSize 1.0 — lines 17 and 33 live on one raised brow). Dark three-piece suit: white shirt, deep ochre waistcoat (his one owned colour — Vermeer's gold), dark jacket, dark tie; slim W .68, legLen 1.24, armLen .92; no hat, no glasses — his face is never covered.
name: Han
